summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), and test/test_extras/test_extras_shacl.py with a parametrized test over valid and invalid shapes plus a non-node input test. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (39 passed) under the shared venv. Not verified: mypy, black, isort, and ruff were not run because they are not in the shared venv and I was told not to install anything; line lengths were checked by hand (all under 88). Nothing was committed.
